facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine to Warwick the smith; this is their side of the deal for borrowing his mithril shirt.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's heirloom armor, which they hold on loan.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
Warwick holds the party's plate armor, which Sir Phidipaldi claims is Sir Brandon's original, as collateral. The party can reclaim it once they bring the metal.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine's entrance and blocks getting metal for Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has partly cleared it and found a dead dwarf's arm in the rubble.
